The audit gate (scripts/audit-gate.mjs) fails on every high/critical finding that
is NOT listed here, and fails on any entry past its reviewBy date — so an
exception rots into a build failure instead of quietly becoming permanent.

Empty is the healthy state. GHSA-qwww-vcr4-c8h2 (react-router) was removed on 2026-08-08: react-router-dom reached 7.18.2, which fixes it upstream, so the exception stopped matching any advisory. The gate treats a non-matching entry as STALE and fails on it — an accepted risk must not outlive the risk.
